covers: JSE morning session on Thursday 19 November 2026, up to about 10:48 SAST, ahead of the SARB rate decision
headline: Investec falls 6.5% after interim results despite an 8.4% rise in headline earnings; the rand holds near R17.25/$ before SARB
summary: Investec Ltd fell 6.5% to R124.75 and Investec plc 6.8% to R126.65 by 10:33 SAST after reporting an 8.4% rise in half-year headline earnings per share to 39.8p and an 18.5p interim dividend (Reuters via CNBC Africa; LRC Stock Scanner, 19 Nov 2026). The JSE All Share was at 106,475.4 at 10:48 SAST, about flat on Wednesday's 106,571.7 close, and the rand was at R17.25 per dollar ahead of today's SARB decision with the repo rate at 7.25% (LRC Market Dashboard). Gold was at $3,736 and platinum at $1,373; US markets open at 16:30 SAST, so Wednesday's mixed close (S&P 500 -0.2%, Nasdaq +0.4%) is still the latest US read.

items.title: Investec Ltd -6.5% and Investec plc -6.8% after interim results; ratings unchanged
items.summary: Investec reported headline earnings per share of 39.8 pence for the six months to 30 Sep 2026, up 8.4% from 36.7 pence, and declared an interim dividend of 18.5 pence, citing more client activity and a larger average loan book (Reuters via CNBC Africa, 19 Nov 2026). The shares fell anyway: Investec Ltd was at R124.75 (-6.5%) and Investec plc at R126.65 (-6.8%) at 10:33 SAST (LRC Stock Scanner), deeper than the -3.4% seen at 09:32. Both are rated HOLD by the LRC Stock Scanner (scores 67 and 62, valuation 'undervalued'); this note does not change either rating.
items.source: Reuters via CNBC Africa, 19 Nov 2026; LRC Stock Scanner quotes, 19 Nov 2026 10:33 SAST

items.title: Pick n Pay +5.9% to R26.29; rating unchanged
items.summary: Pick n Pay traded at R26.29 at 10:33 SAST on 19 Nov 2026, up 5.9% on the day, having been up 7.1% at 09:32 (LRC Stock Scanner quotes). We have still not found a company announcement behind the move, so treat it as unexplained for now. The LRC Stock Scanner rates Pick n Pay BUY (score 66, valuation 'fair value'); the rating is unchanged. Its last results (26 weeks to 30 Aug 2026, published 26 Oct 2026) showed a headline loss of 40.71c per share, narrower than 59.77c a year earlier.
items.source: LRC Stock Scanner, 19 Nov 2026 10:33 SAST; Pick n Pay SENS 26 Oct 2026

items.title: S&P 500 -0.2% at 7,323.63; Nasdaq +0.4% at 24,429.89
items.summary: The S&P 500 closed Wednesday at 7,323.63 against Tuesday's 7,340.53 (-0.2%), and the Nasdaq Composite at 24,429.89 against 24,328.38 (+0.4%). Both are about 3% below Friday 13 November (S&P 7,561.67; Nasdaq 25,136.27). Big single-share moves at the close included Palo Alto Networks +9.9%, UnitedHealth -10.2%, Take-Two +6.2% and Broadcom +3.6%.

items.title: SARB rate decision today; repo rate at 7.25%
items.summary: The SARB Monetary Policy Committee announces its decision on Thursday 19 November. The repo rate has been 7.25% since September's 25bp hike. October CPI, released on Wednesday, was 5.2% (September 4.5%).
